scientific_question: On genuine two-decision workflows, does node-level all-branch LOO reduce policy drift at a known non-causal target compared with trajectory-broadcast GRPO, while preserving the ability to learn causal target actions?

v2_terminal_record.failure_class: The stochastic v2 smoke reused one task-derived root seed for all eight episodes, producing one byte-identical root draw eight times. Its sampled reward-variation stop rule could not distinguish integration failure from uniform success or ordinary bad luck.
v2_terminal_record.accepted_disposition: Terminal failure; v2 remains closed and is never retried.

distinct_campaign_justification.rules_question: v2 prohibited a second v2 campaign after its first model call. v3 is a separately frozen campaign after accepting and reporting v2's terminal result.
distinct_campaign_justification.anti_bias_basis: No v2 scientific arm started and no arm comparison, policy update endpoint, or scientific threshold was observed. The v2 data exposed only an execution-address collision and a stochastic gate-design defect.
changes_permitted: Address root randomness by task name plus a stable episode address while preserving common random numbers within each ReDCO episode.
Replace the sampled integration pass condition with deterministic constrained route/action completions.
Measure route and target action probabilities exactly and apply a frozen analytical power gate before scientific arms.
Remove all sampled route, reward, and trainability conditions from scientific early aborts.
Retire seeds 9301-9304 and 9401-9404 and use fresh seeds 9501-9504.
Update source hashes, rendered config hashes, and hardware availability.
distinct_campaign_justification.scientific_rules_change: None. frozen_metrics_and_decision is byte-identical to v1 and v2.

tasks.confusion_irrelevant: The root route changes reward; the targeted digit has no effect. This is the primary credit-confusion endpoint.
tasks.confusion_redundant: Reward succeeds when either root route delta or target digit 5 succeeds.
tasks.confusion_lucky: Target digit 5 and root route are causal while an episode-level +/-1 luck term is shared by every branch.
tasks.common_random_numbers: For one ReDCO episode, root route and episode luck are sampled once and held fixed across all 11 target branches.
tasks.episode_diversity: Different episodes of the same task receive distinct deterministic root seeds via stable rollout addresses.

support_guard.failure_action: Stop v3 before scientific arms and classify it as a terminal underpowered design, not an algorithm failure.

arms.broadcast: Stock GRPO trajectory advantage assigned to root and target decisions.
arms.sliced: ReDCO trajectory LOO at the root and 11-branch LOO at the target with sliced replay.

design.excluded_arm: Full-suffix replay is not repeated because prior live sliced-vs-full outcome equivalence already passed; this gate isolates credit.
design.one_campaign_rule: After the first Stage C3 v3 model call, do not retry, substitute hardware, change thresholds, change source, or launch a second v3 campaign. A gate failure is terminal and scientific arms do not run.

frozen_metrics_and_decision.policy_distribution: For each recorded prefix, normalize exact vLLM temperature-2 probabilities over digit tokens 0-7 and compute Jensen-Shannon divergence from the shared warm start.

primary_irrelevant_target.exposure_floor: Mean broadcast JS divergence across seeds must be at least 0.002; otherwise status is underpowered.
primary_irrelevant_target.directional_effect: Mean sliced JS divergence must be at most 75% of mean broadcast JS divergence.
primary_irrelevant_target.pairwise_guard: For each seed, sliced JS may not exceed paired broadcast JS by more than 0.002.

causal_sanity.rule: On each causal probe, at least one arm must increase exact digit-5 mass by at least 0.05 from initialization.
causal_sanity.calls_to_threshold: First aligned policy-call point whose sampled evaluation target-success rate is at least 0.5.
causal_sanity.comparison: Calls-to-threshold is reported for both arms as a compute tradeoff; ReDCO is not required to beat broadcast because it receives fewer optimizer steps at matched calls.

frozen_metrics_and_decision.saturation_guard: If any exact final digit-5 mass is at least 0.98, endpoint margins are forbidden and only the frozen calls-to-threshold curve is used for sample-efficiency interpretation.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.pass: Every support, primary, causal-sanity, completeness, and aligned-evaluation check in the frozen verifier passes.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.underpowered: Either initialization support fails or the broadcast exposure floor is not met.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.fail: The gate is adequately exposed but one or more other mandatory checks fail.
frozen_metrics_and_decision.claim_limit: A pass supports reduced nuisance drift on this small mechanistic battery, not a broad population claim.

decision_rule_identity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true and separators=(',', ':')
decision_rule_identity.requirement: The machine audit must prove canonical bytes are identical across v1, v2, and v3 before any v3 model call.

execution.stable_episode_address: Prime dispatcher appends episode:<zero-based-index> to the policy-version cache salt for each environment rollout in a group.
execution.end_to_end_regression: A mock model drives RedcoCreditEnv.run through the real route and branch path, asserts a 64-token root budget, parseable route, deterministic branch rewards, and nonzero trainable credit. Separate tests assert stable/distinct episode addresses and forced smoke choices.

checks: Every forced route/action/reward triple is exact.
Every route and every digit is represented.
The trainer reaches its first aggregate row with no rollout errors, the root token-budget contract intact, and nonzero trainable credit.
forced_integration_smoke.failure_action: Recover artifacts, terminate the pod, record terminal v3 failure, and run no later gate or scientific arm.

exact_power_gate.measurement: Use exact full-vocabulary vLLM log probabilities at the forced smoke's actual root and target prefixes, retempered analytically to temperature 2. Route probabilities are exact complete-sequence probabilities including EOS.
exact_power_gate.failure_action: Stop v3 before scientific arms, preserve the exact measurements, and classify the design as terminal underpowered.

checks: Every context trace reports a root completion budget of at least eight tokens.

scientific_early_abort.failure_action: Stop the campaign immediately, recover artifacts, and do not retry after any model call.

pre_model_call_checks: Verify every frozen source and rendered-config hash.
Run root tests, affected WSL environment tests, Prime episode-address/algorithm tests, config parsing, invariant tests, exact-power tests, and verifier tests.
Require the end-to-end mock rollout regression to pass.
Apply no uncommitted root-project source edits; the expected external Prime submodule patch must reverse-apply exactly.
Reconstruct and hash the selected merged warm start.
Run the machine audit proving decision-rule identity, fresh seeds, v2 terminal-bundle identity, deterministic smoke, exact power settings, zero sampled scientific aborts, and all hashes.
execution.failure_handling: After any failure, recover all existing artifacts, record the terminal result, and do not retry after a model call.
execution.artifacts: Sync all logs, metrics, traces, exact score payloads, verifier outputs, and final adapters locally. Store each final adapter as an independently hashed zstd or gzip archive and omit redundant intermediate adapter broadcasts after recording hashes.
execution.teardown: Always terminate compute after artifact recovery and confirm zero persistent disks.

hardware.availability_observed: 2026-07-28 before freeze: two standard 2xL40S offerings, 2126e0 and fcbec2, were listed Available at $2.00/hour; no cheaper eligible 2x48GB A40, A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, or RTX 8000 offering was listed.
hardware.fallback_rule: Do not silently substitute fcbec2 or any other resource. If 2126e0 is unavailable before the first model call, commit a hardware-only amendment and repeat the hash audit.
hardware.ssh_rule: Verify SSH noninteractively immediately after provisioning; terminate without model calls if it fails.

rendered_configs.parse_validation: All ten v3 TOML files, including the static forced smoke, parsed through Prime-RL RLConfig before freeze.
